findings.passage: In the Federalism, Military Affairs and Elections Committee, also on Wednesday, Representative Alex Kolodin’s HCR2001 was presented.  This is the “Florida Style” vote counting bill, which will also tighten up security on mail-in balloting (by mandating voters to verify addresses and request a mail-in ballot before each election), a measure that voters are begging for so our state isn’t the butt of all elections jokes.
